conversations.say: Maren, worker protections and neighborhood logistics have to go hand in hand tonight. If Veridian wants local legitimacy, we need enforceable commitments for your contractors and our couriers before anyone trades away our people.
conversations.offer: Neighborhood coalition support and coordination on labor protection
conversations.request: A joint stance ensuring no institutional disclosure occurs without guaranteed local benefit

conversations.say: Dee, someone is offering cash for the service route name, and Morgan's asking questions about the camera gap. We need a strict boundary right now before outsiders tie you to the access arrangement I helped set up.
conversations.offer: Mutual defense against outside scrutiny regarding the unlogged back room access
conversations.request: Agreement on what details we keep locked down before investigators piece together the timeline

conversations.say: Arden, welcome to the floor. We're glad to host, but neighborhood history isn't free scenery. What is Veridian prepared to put in writing tonight regarding shared authority and protection for local witnesses?
conversations.offer: Legitimacy and local cooperation for Veridian's anniversary event
conversations.request: A concrete, written institutional commitment protecting neighborhood infrastructure and residents

public_statement: If Veridian or City Hall thinks our streets and service routes are open data for their anniversary stories, they've got another thing coming. We protect our own here.

commitments.promise: Coordinate a shared disclosure boundary regarding the service route and camera gap to protect Dee from unfair blame.
